title: Deeper/broader ACadSharp-derived parser and DWG structural-checker screen
mode: primary-source web research and read-only local plan/test-owner reconciliation
scope: Screen the acad-ts TypeScript reader/writer for independent implementation lineage and bounded comparison value
Screen dwg-verifier structural and composed validation scope, speed claims, and platform limitations
Reconcile candidate value with the existing fast-first DWG/DXF implementation queue and external-only gates

method.limitations: Assessment uses mutable public README/repository pages and project-reported benchmark/platform statements. No peer artifact was pinned or executed; no native route or local behavior was qualified.

sources.observation: The README identifies acad-ts as a port from ACadSharp and names its upstream baseline and last-compared commits. It lists DWG/DXF read/write version availability while warning that the matrix is not complete object/property coverage; it also describes version-specific writer/reader limitations.
sources.limits: The mutable repository branch, npm listing, and a supported-version matrix do not prove artifact behavior or independent parser lineage. No package was downloaded or run.

sources.observation: Tier 1 is documented as AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 container validation and explicitly excludes drawing-object interpretation. Tier 2 composes ODA File Converter with ezdxf recovery/audit. The README reports 101 tests at about 2 seconds without ODA, about 17 seconds with it, and about 45 seconds for its corruption table; it also documents repair visibility and platform/version limitations.
sources.limits: Timing and coverage are project-reported. No repository was cloned, no tool run occurred, and the checker does not independently establish entity semantics, ACDSDATA associations, ACIS geometry, or native CAD acceptance.

sources.project: Local libdxfrw plan and test-owner reconciliation
sources.observation: The plan already has distinct structural, object, semantic, association, ACIS, and native-acceptance gates; local generated fast tests are available for targeted coverage. The screen adds no confirmed gap and does not warrant a duplicate test, external dependency, or slower per-slice validation.
sources.limits: No local build or test was run; source/test-name inspection is not execution evidence.

assessment.planImpact: Adds acad-ts as an ACadSharp-derived comparison candidate rather than an independent parser vote, and dwg-verifier as a structural-corruption test-design reference rather than a semantic validator. Existing fast-first order, cadence, support claims, fixture policy, and external-only deferrals remain unchanged.
